ripple_prime.business_model: Non-bank institutional prime broker; not a trading venue; no retail clients.
ripple_prime.collateral_claim: XRP is listed alongside RLUSD, tokenized real-world assets and traditional collateral in the assets institutions can post into Ripple Prime's collateral framework; the page explicitly confirms RLUSD accepted as collateral.

us_spot_launch.claim: U.S.-based institutional clients can execute OTC spot XRP/RLUSD and cross-margin OTC spot holdings with OTC swaps and CME futures/options.

ripple_prime.distinction: Prime-broker collateral eligibility and internal cross-margining do not establish that CME Clearing directly accepts XRP.

debt_facility.classification: Corporate debt facility to finance clients; not an XRP purchase or disclosed XRP collateral balance.

cftc_letter_26_05.legal_character: Staff no-action position subject to conditions; not a Commission rule or automatic asset approval.

initial_ramp_up.timing: Tied to each FCM's notice/reliance conditions, not a universal calendar start.

after_initial_phase.futures_and_cleared_swaps_customer_accou: The digital asset must be accepted by the relevant registered DCO/foreign clearing organization; DCO haircuts and other conditions apply.
after_initial_phase.cftc_30_7_customer_accounts: May include a payment stablecoin, an asset accepted by a DCO/foreign clearing organization, or the underlying commodity of a futures contract listed on a CFTC-registered DCM, subject to conditions, notice, risk controls and applicable haircuts/capital charges.

xrp_path.potential_30_7_route: XRP is the underlying commodity of CME-listed XRP futures, so it may fit the post-ramp 30.7 underlying-commodity category if an FCM meets all conditions and files the required notice.

cme_clearing.interpretation: CME Clearing's current public acceptable-collateral list does not list XRP or crypto assets. CME may review requests, but acceptance is discretionary and requires credit-risk review.

coinbase.collateral_disclosure: Q3 2026 filing reports aggregate lending and customer collateral, but no XRP-specific amount; other crypto assets are aggregated.
coinbase.cftc_letter_requester: Coinbase Financial Markets requested CFTC Staff Letter 26-05.
coinbase.rlusd_global_exchange_collateral: Forthcoming in Ripple's launch announcement; not verified live.

sec_cftc_classification.legal_limit: The release says it does not supersede Howey. A non-security crypto asset can still be offered or sold subject to an investment contract. Interpretive guidance is not a comprehensive market-structure statute.

issuer_entity_separation.ripple_national_trust_bank: separate from Standard Custody & Trust Company, RLUSD issuer
issuer_entity_separation.circle_national_trust_bank: separate from Circle Internet Financial LLC, USDC issuer
issuer_entity_separation.note: A national trust-bank charter does not automatically change the legal issuer of RLUSD or USDC.

ripple_prime_collateral.text: Ripple Prime advertises XRP, RLUSD, tokenized real-world assets and traditional collateral as postable assets.

ripple_prime_cross_margin.text: U.S. clients can cross-margin OTC spot holdings with CME futures and options through Ripple Prime.

cftc_initial_phase.text: During the first three months, participating FCMs may accept only payment stablecoins, Bitcoin and Ether as customer margin collateral.

cftc_30_7.text: For 30.7 accounts, an underlying commodity of a futures contract listed on a CFTC-registered DCM can qualify after the initial phase, subject to the letter's conditions.

cftc_dco.text: Futures and cleared-swaps customer collateral must be accepted by a registered DCO and valued using that DCO's haircuts.

coinbase_collateral.text: Coinbase's Q3 filing aggregates other crypto collateral and does not disclose an XRP-specific amount.

sec_xrp.text: The March 2026 SEC-CFTC interpretation lists XRP among digital commodities; it is interpretive guidance, not a statute.

clarity.text: Evernorth's November 9 filing says the CLARITY Act had not been enacted and Senate cloture failed in August 2026.

genius.text: As of the November 9 filing, GENIUS Act implementing rules were still proposed, not final.

rationale: Ripple Prime advertises a capability but no XRP posted balances, haircuts or utilization are disclosed.
CFTC 26-05 is a conditional staff no-action position; no FCM notice or XRP collateral use is verified.
CME Clearing's public acceptable-collateral list does not include XRP.
Coinbase's Q3 filing does not disclose an XRP-specific collateral amount.
Prime-broker collateral, FCM customer margin and DCO collateral are distinct layers.
